stage: Before any relation-quality raw/count predictions or this study GT scoring; earlier DEV diagnostics and transfer/query-consistency results known
inspiration: Within-object nuisance elimination, bounded-influence convex estimation, and transport across observed visual states. Not a claim that classical score calibration is our innovation.
model_assumption: Teacher clipped logit within query/TrackID/view/video equals a stable additive object/channel effect plus a common nonnegative coefficient times query-oriented horizontal position plus noise. TrackID purity, query reference-frame interpretation, and additive specification can fail.

teacher_only_fit.coefficient: single scalar per pair/video-prefix, never future videos

reference: Mean query-oriented positions of paid unique single-frame observations, averaged within each view and then across views. Unqueried cells use the same uniformly spaced up-to-three observation indices as the frozen PCD source.
intervention: logit(base_qt)+clip(beta*(oriented_position_qtf-reference_qt),-ln(3),ln(3)); beta=0 or unsupported query gives exact base fallback
query_gate: Conservative literal absolute left/right; exclude motion, team names, orientation and reference-object expressions. 246 KITTI queries per setting eligible; other four settings currently no eligible query. No dataset-specific numerical rule.

ordinary_frame_KD.features: 1087D: same 768 PCD+312 query-conditioned RGB+1 appearance cue, normalized box centre xy/width/height, oriented x, and same gate indicator
ordinary_frame_KD.target: Mean raw answers at each query/track/requested-frame after exact request dedup, per-view aggregation. All actually requested views including CLIP anchor; all queries, not just our gated subgroup.
ordinary_frame_KD.offset: Causally emitted ordinary RAW_RGB_FINAL from the same past/current video, never final future-trained checkpoint
ordinary_frame_KD.fitting: Same 64 GELU head/AdamW/confidence weights/min4000,max16000/teacher KL<=.005 stopping; final checkpoint only; do not use GT to select training recipe
ordinary_frame_KD.inference: All candidate observations, 4096-row GPU batches; exact all-observation prefix feature moments without giant feature expansion

ablations.time_average: Average new per-frame probabilities on each track, retaining its base-rate change but eliminating temporal alignment
ablations.shuffle: Deterministic nonzero circular per-track permutation, preserving every per-track probability value
ablations.uncentered: Same beta and base, reference fixed .5 rather than observed object states
ablations.raw_RGB: Same relational transport on ordinary RGB head; isolates conditional structure and interaction

quantity_control: Both count donors; equal counts per query/frame; rank on per-observation scores, not old coarse scores; prior then supplied TrackID break ties; CountSelf must exactly reproduce official files
GT_rule: All450 raw/count outputs sealed before this study official target GT evaluator. Core/supplements have their own independent output barriers.
scheduling: Wait for all18 flat-RGB ordinary GPU conditions to finish, then internal memory preflight and preserve valid per-video checkpoints
acceptance: Research candidate only. Requires wins against adequately fitted ordinary frame and coarse baselines, temporal/conditional contribution and CountMatched; no guarantee of positive HOTA; no posthoc higher control promotion.
tests: 8 mathematical/information-path checks passed; real C1/C2/C4 frame-label feature construction passed with zero GT reads and no GPU
